products.name: Ruby Noor Velvet Lehenga
products.description: Heirloom-grade deep crimson velvet lehenga adorned with antique zari embroidery, hand-sewn sequins, and heavy gold borders. Comes with a matching embellished blouse and custom silk organza dupatta.

products.name: Emerald Mehr Couture Lehenga
products.description: Stunning forest green hand-embroidered lehenga in pure raw silk. Features elaborate dori and gota patti work with intricate peacock motifs. Pair it with double dupatta for a majestic bridal statement.

products.name: Ivory Vow Pearl Lehenga
products.description: Elegant champagne ivory georgette lehenga with delicate white pearl and silver thread embroidery. Specially crafted for engagement ceremonies and modern day-wedding themes.

products.name: Rose Saanjh Banarasi Saree
products.description: Exquisite blush pink Banarasi silk saree woven with real gold and silver zari threads (Zari brocade). Features traditional floral patterns (Jal) with an ornate pallu.
